- **No schema breaking changes** — additive migrations only

- Risk: requeue stampede if too many stuck scans → mitigation: limit to 50 at a time + button confirms count first

End of sprint, what tests + manual checks prove this works:

23	    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,
24	    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY!,

48	 *
49	 * Wrapped in React cache() so repeated calls within the same render tree
50	 * (e.g. layout + page) are deduplicated — only one round-trip per request.
51	 *
52	 * Returns null when the user is not authenticated or profile is missing.

55	  const supabase = await createClient()

58	  if (authError || !user) return null

63	    .eq('id', user.id)
64	    .single()

5	/**
6	 * Updates the session on every request to prevent session expiry.
7	 *
8	 * CRITICAL: This function rewrites cookies on BOTH the request (for downstream
9	 * reads in the same request cycle) AND the response (for the browser to send
10	 * the updated session token on the next request).
11	 *
12	 * This is the Next.js 16 pattern — middleware.ts calls this.
13	 */
14	export async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {
15	  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({ request })
16	
17	  const supabase = createServerClient<Database>(
18	    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,
19	    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY!,
20	    {
21	      cookies: {
22	        getAll() {
23	          return request.cookies.getAll()
24	        },
25	        setAll(cookiesToSet) {
26	          // Write on the request so downstream server components can read it
27	          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value }) => request.cookies.set(name, value))
28	          // Rebuild the response with the updated request cookies
29	          supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({ request })
30	          // Write on the response so the browser stores the refreshed token
31	          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =>
32	            supabaseResponse.cookies.set(name, value, options)
33	          )
34	        },
35	      },
36	    }
37	  )
38	
39	  // IMPORTANT: Always use getUser() — never getSession() for auth checks.
40	  // getUser() validates the JWT against the Supabase server.
41	  const {
42	    data: { user },
43	  } = await supabase.auth.getUser()
44	
45	  const path = request.nextUrl.pathname
46	
47	  // Redirect unauthenticated users away from protected routes
48	  if (!user) {
49	    const isProtected =
50	      path.startsWith('/dashboard') ||
51	      path.startsWith('/scan') ||
52	      path.startsWith('/reports') ||
53	      path.startsWith('/history') ||
54	      path.startsWith('/monitoring') ||
55	      path.startsWith('/integrations') ||
56	      path.startsWith('/settings') ||
57	      path.startsWith('/api-settings') ||
58	      path.startsWith('/competitors') ||
59	      path.startsWith('/referrals') ||
60	      path.startsWith('/team') ||
61	      path.startsWith('/admin')
62	
63	    if (isProtected) {
64	      const redirectUrl = request.nextUrl.clone()
65	      redirectUrl.pathname = '/login'
66	      redirectUrl.searchParams.set('redirectedFrom', path)
67	      return NextResponse.redirect(redirectUrl)
68	    }

# ARCHITECTURE — CROBOT Admin Panel Sprint 1

**Target file to deliver (post-plan-mode):** `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/CROBOT/ARCHITECTURE-SPRINT-1.md`
**Stack:** Next.js 16 App Router, React 19, TS strict, Supabase cloud (`ovlreynsgoccjzvczglp`), Tailwind v4, shadcn/ui, pnpm 9.15.4.
**Sprint 1 features:** Impersonation · Manual Credits · Activity Timeline · Queue Monitor+Requeue · Error Log Viewer.
**Constraints:** additive migrations only · admin-only UI · <30s migration · no new deps.

---

## 1. Data model — migration `supabase/migrations/015_admin_support_ops.sql`

Reuse existing helpers: `public.is_admin()` (from 004), `public.handle_updated_at()` (from 003), `auth.uid()`.
No breaking changes. All `CREATE` statements use `IF NOT EXISTS`. RLS is additive (existing policies remain).

```sql
-- ── Migration 015: Admin Support Ops ──────────────────────────
-- Adds: admin_error_log, admin_impersonation_sessions
-- Additive indexes for scan queue + audit-log activity lookups
-- Safe to run on prod (<30s, no locks on hot tables)

BEGIN;

-- ── is_super_admin() helper (STABLE, SECURITY DEFINER) ────────
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_super_admin()
RETURNS BOOLEAN AS $$
BEGIN
  RETURN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles
    WHERE id = auth.uid() AND role = 'super_admin'
  );
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER STABLE;

-- ── admin_error_log ───────────────────────────────────────────
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.admin_error_log (
  id              UUID        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  occurred_at     TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  severity        TEXT        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'error'
                    CHECK (severity IN ('fatal','error','warning','info')),
  message         TEXT        NOT NULL,
  stack           TEXT,
  source          TEXT        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'server'
                    CHECK (source IN ('server','client','edge','cron')),
  url             TEXT,
  user_id         UUID        REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  route           TEXT,
  metadata        JSONB       NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  resolved        BOOLEAN     NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  resolved_at     TIMESTAMPTZ,
  resolved_by     UUID        REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  resolution_note TEXT
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_admin_error_log_occurred     ON public.admin_error_log (occurred_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_admin_error_log_sev_occurred ON public.admin_error_log (severity, occurred_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_admin_error_log_res_occurred ON public.admin_error_log (resolved, occurred_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_admin_error_log_user         ON public.admin_error_log (user_id);

ALTER TABLE public.admin_error_log ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

CREATE POLICY "error_log_admin_read"
  ON public.admin_error_log FOR SELECT USING (public.is_admin());

-- No INSERT policy → only service_role can insert (bypasses RLS)
-- No UPDATE policy for admin — super_admin only can resolve
CREATE POLICY "error_log_super_admin_update"
  ON public.admin_error_log FOR UPDATE
  USING (public.is_super_admin())
  WITH CHECK (public.is_super_admin());

-- ── admin_impersonation_sessions ──────────────────────────────
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.admin_impersonation_sessions (
  id              UUID        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  admin_user_id   UUID        NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  target_user_id  UUID        NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  started_at      TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  expires_at      TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  ended_at        TIMESTAMPTZ,
  reason          TEXT,
  ip_address      TEXT,
  user_agent      TEXT
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_impersonation_admin_started
  ON public.admin_impersonation_sessions (admin_user_id, started_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_impersonation_target_started
  ON public.admin_impersonation_sessions (target_user_id, started_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_impersonation_active_expires
  ON public.admin_impersonation_sessions (expires_at)
  WHERE ended_at IS NULL;

ALTER TABLE public.admin_impersonation_sessions ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

CREATE POLICY "impersonation_admin_read_own"
  ON public.admin_impersonation_sessions FOR SELECT
  USING (public.is_admin() AND admin_user_id = auth.uid());

CREATE POLICY "impersonation_super_admin_read_all"
  ON public.admin_impersonation_sessions FOR SELECT
  USING (public.is_super_admin());

-- INSERT + UPDATE → service_role only (no policy = RLS denies non-service)

-- ── Additive indexes for queue + activity ─────────────────────
-- Composite index for "stuck/failed scans" queue page
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_scans_status_created
  ON public.scans (status, created_at DESC);

-- Existing idx_audit_logs_target is (target_type, target_id) — adequate for
-- activity timeline lookups filtered by (target_type='user', target_id=<uuid>).
-- No new index needed. Document decision: skipped (duplicate of existing).

COMMIT;
```

**Trigger reuse:** `admin_error_log` has no `updated_at` column (immutable audit-style — only `resolved_at` is set once). `admin_impersonation_sessions` likewise. No triggers needed.

**Estimated run time:** <2s (small DDL, no backfill, no table rewrite).

---

## 2. Server actions — `app/actions/admin/`

New directory. Each file exports async functions marked `'use server'`. All imports from `@/lib/supabase/server`. All audit entries use `audit_logs` (admin_id + action + target_type + target_id + metadata). All input validated with Zod. Return shape: `{ ok: true, data } | { ok: false, error: string, code: string }`.

**Shared guard helpers (new file `app/actions/admin/_guard.ts`):**

```ts
export async function requireAdmin() {
  const auth = await getAuthenticatedUser()
  if (!auth) throw new ActionError('UNAUTHENTICATED', 'Sign in required')
  if (!['admin','super_admin'].includes(auth.user.role))
    throw new ActionError('FORBIDDEN', 'Admin required')
  return auth
}
export async function requireSuperAdmin() { /* same but role === 'super_admin' */ }
export class ActionError extends Error { constructor(public code: string, m: string) { super(m) } }
```

### 2.1 `app/actions/admin/impersonation.ts`

```ts
'use server'
// impersonateUser(input): super_admin only
export const impersonateSchema = z.object({
  targetUserId: z.string().uuid(),
  reason: z.string().min(10).max(500),
})
export async function impersonateUser(input: z.infer<typeof impersonateSchema>):
  Promise<{ ok: true; redirectTo: string } | { ok: false; error: string; code: string }>
```

- Auth gate: `requireSuperAdmin()`
- Target checks: target exists, `target.role !== 'super_admin'` (prevent privilege escalation)
- Client: `createServiceRoleClient()` (inserts + audit bypass RLS)
- Writes row to `admin_impersonation_sessions` with `expires_at = now() + 30 min`, captures `ip_address` + `user_agent` from `headers()`
- Sets signed cookie (see §3)
- Audit log: `{ action: 'impersonate.start', target_type: 'user', target_id: targetUserId, metadata: { session_id, reason, expires_at } }`
- Returns `{ ok: true, redirectTo: '/dashboard' }`

### 2.2 `app/actions/admin/impersonation.ts::endImpersonation()`

- No input (reads cookie)
- Auth gate: `requireAdmin()` (own admin's cookie only)
- Verifies cookie HMAC → extracts `session_id`
- Updates `admin_impersonation_sessions.ended_at = now()` via service role
- Clears cookie
- Audit log: `action: 'impersonate.end'`
- Returns `{ ok: true, redirectTo: '/admin/users/{target_id}' }`

### 2.3 `app/actions/admin/credits.ts`

```ts
export const grantCreditsSchema = z.object({
  userId: z.string().uuid(),
  amount: z.number().int().min(1).max(1000),
  reason: z.string().min(5).max(500),
})
export async function grantScanCredits(input): Promise<ActionResult<{ newLimit: number }>>
```

- Auth gate: `requireSuperAdmin()`
- Client: `createServiceRoleClient()`
- Atomic SQL: `UPDATE profiles SET scan_limit = scan_limit + $1 WHERE id = $2 RETURNING scan_limit`
- Audit log: `action: 'credits.grant', target_type: 'user', target_id: userId, metadata: { amount, reason, new_limit }`

### 2.4 `app/actions/admin/queue.ts::requeueStuckScans(olderThanMinutes)`

```ts
export const requeueStuckSchema = z.object({
  olderThanMinutes: z.number().int().min(5).max(1440).default(15),
})
export async function requeueStuckScans(input): Promise<ActionResult<{ count: number }>>
```

- Auth gate: `requireAdmin()`
- Client: `createServiceRoleClient()`
- Query: `UPDATE scans SET status='pending', error_message=null WHERE status='analyzing' AND created_at < now() - make_interval(mins => $1) LIMIT 50 RETURNING id`
- Hard cap 50 (risk mitigation — see §8)
- Audit log: `action: 'queue.requeue_bulk', metadata: { count, scan_ids, threshold_minutes }`

### 2.5 `app/actions/admin/queue.ts::requeueSingleScan(scanId)`

- Auth gate: `requireAdmin()`
- `UPDATE scans SET status='pending', error_message=null WHERE id=$1 AND status IN ('failed','analyzing')`
- Audit log: `action: 'queue.requeue_single', target_type: 'scan', target_id: scanId`

### 2.6 `app/actions/admin/errors.ts::resolveErrorLog(errorId, note)`

```ts
export const resolveErrorSchema = z.object({
  errorId: z.string().uuid(),
  note: z.string().min(3).max(1000),
})
```

- Auth gate: `requireSuperAdmin()`
- Client: `createClient()` (session) — RLS policy `error_log_super_admin_update` already enforces
- `UPDATE admin_error_log SET resolved=true, resolved_at=now(), resolved_by=auth.uid(), resolution_note=$2 WHERE id=$1`
- Audit log: `action: 'errorlog.resolve', target_type: 'error_log', target_id: errorId`

**After every mutation:** call `revalidatePath()` on affected admin page.

---

## 3. Impersonation cookie design

**Env var (new):** `IMPERSONATION_COOKIE_SECRET` — 32+ random bytes base64. Add to `.env.local` + Supabase Edge secrets doc + Railway. If missing at runtime, action throws `CONFIG_ERROR` (fail loud). Do NOT reuse `SUPABASE_JWT_SECRET` (different rotation lifecycle).

**Cookie name:** `convertscan_impersonation`
**Value format:** `base64url(<payload>).<hmac_b64url>` where `<payload> = {admin_id}.{target_id}.{session_id}.{expires_ts}`
**HMAC:** `crypto.createHmac('sha256', SECRET).update(payload).digest('base64url')`
**Attrs:** `HttpOnly; Secure (prod only); SameSite=Lax; Path=/; Max-Age=1800`

**Helper `lib/admin/impersonation-cookie.ts`:**
```ts
export function signImpersonationCookie(p: Payload): string
export function verifyImpersonationCookie(raw: string): Payload | null  // returns null on bad HMAC or expired
export const IMPERSONATION_COOKIE = 'convertscan_impersonation'
```

**Middleware integration (`lib/supabase/middleware.ts`) — diff:**

Insert AFTER `const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser()` (line 43) and BEFORE the `if (!user)` block:

```ts
// Impersonation override — verify cookie, attach target_id to response headers
const impCookie = request.cookies.get('convertscan_impersonation')?.value
if (impCookie && user) {
  const payload = verifyImpersonationCookie(impCookie)
  if (payload && payload.admin_id === user.id && payload.expires_ts > Date.now()) {
    // Pass acting-as to Server Components via request header
    supabaseResponse.headers.set('x-impersonating-user', payload.target_id)
    supabaseResponse.headers.set('x-impersonation-session', payload.session_id)
  } else {
    // Bad/expired cookie — clear it
    supabaseResponse.cookies.delete('convertscan_impersonation')
  }
}
```

**`getAuthenticatedUser` override:** extend `lib/supabase/server.ts` with a new helper (does NOT change existing function signature):

```ts
export const getEffectiveUser = cache(async (): Promise<AuthenticatedUser | null> => {
  const headerStore = await headers()
  const impersonatingId = headerStore.get('x-impersonating-user')
  const admin = await getAuthenticatedUser()
  if (!admin) return null
  if (!impersonatingId) return admin
  // Load target profile via service role (admin already authorized)
  const sr = createServiceRoleClient()
  const { data: target } = await sr.from('profiles').select('*').eq('id', impersonatingId).single()
  if (!target) return admin
  return { user: { ...(target as ProfileRow), authId: impersonatingId } }
})
```

User-facing pages (dashboard, scan, reports, settings) switch from `getAuthenticatedUser()` to `getEffectiveUser()`. Admin pages (`/admin/*`) keep `getAuthenticatedUser()` (impersonation never grants admin-of-admin).

**Banner:** `components/admin/ImpersonationBanner.tsx` (Client Component) reads from a new hook `useImpersonation()` which calls a tiny route `GET /api/admin/impersonate/state` that returns `{ active, targetEmail, expiresAt }` (reads header in route handler). Rendered at top of `AppShell`. Red bg, "Acting as {email} — {countdown} — [Exit]".

**Exit route:** `POST /api/admin/impersonate/end` → calls `endImpersonation()` → clears cookie via response → returns `{ redirectTo }`.

**Write-action policy during impersonation:** admin CAN perform writes as the target (intentional — used to reproduce bugs). All writes server-side check header `x-impersonation-session` and stamp audit_logs with both admin_id + impersonated_user_id in metadata. Destructive actions (delete account, change plan to paid, issue refund) remain BLOCKED — add a `guardDestructive()` helper.

### 4.1 Server helper — `lib/errors/log-server.ts`

## 8. Risks + mitigations

| Risk | Severity | Mitigation |
|---|---|---|
| Impersonation cookie forgery | Critical | HMAC-SHA256 with server-only secret; 30-min TTL; server-side verification every request in middleware; payload includes `admin_id` cross-checked vs session |
| Admin impersonates another admin → escalation | High | Action rejects when `target.role === 'super_admin'`; RLS on admin pages uses `getAuthenticatedUser()` not `getEffectiveUser()` |
| Accidental destructive action during impersonation | Medium | `guardDestructive()` helper blocks account delete / plan-to-paid / refund when `x-impersonation-session` header present |
| `admin_error_log` fills DB (disk pressure) | Medium | Index `(resolved, occurred_at DESC)` for fast cleanup; Sprint 2 adds pg_cron retention (90d for resolved, 365d for unresolved-fatal) |
| Requeue stampede on many stuck scans | Medium | Hard `LIMIT 50` per call; UI confirms count first; audit logs the scan_ids |
| Error POST endpoint abused (DoS / log spam) | Medium | In-memory IP rate limit 30/5min; Zod size caps (message 2KB, stack 20KB); Sprint 2: Redis bucket + anomaly alert |
| Missing `IMPERSONATION_COOKIE_SECRET` in prod | High | Fail loud at action invocation (`CONFIG_ERROR`); Bolt deploy checklist must include this var |
| Activity RPC leaks cross-user data | Critical | RPC top-checks `is_admin()`; SECURITY DEFINER STABLE; Sage verifies with anon + plain-user test |
| Middleware regression breaks public routes | High | Impersonation logic gated on `user &&` truthy; public flow untouched; Playwright smoke test of /login + /pricing in Sage review |
